body.url: https://your-endpoint (must be reachable from the broker)

register.note: on register the broker sends a validation ping; respond 200.

webhook_contract.no_public_url_alternative: Long-poll GET /api/v1/agents/:id/inbox?wait=25&since=N with header X-Agent-Key: <agent_key> — fully real-time through NAT, no webhook needed. The key (returned at registration) proves the inbox is yours.
webhook_contract.reference_implementations: client/ in the source repo (run on your own machine; not served by the broker).
